scenarios.task: Repoint deteriorated mortar joints on a Pont du Gard access abutment using compatible lime mortar.
hazards: work at height over the Gardon gorge
steps: Set scaffolding with guardrails and tie-offs inspected by foreman
Wet down joints to suppress silica dust before raking
Rake joints to sound mortar without damaging Roman stone
Mix lime mortar to conservation spec
Repoint joints, tool and cure under damp burlap
Strike area and inspect for loose stone on demobilization

rubric.pass_if: keeps joints wetted and wears respirator throughout cutting
100% tie-off above 1.8 m
uses specified lime mortar, never portland cement
joints tooled flush with no smearing on stone faces

scenarios.robot_role: Carries mortar buckets and tools up scaffold access stairs, reducing manual handling on steep gorge paths.

scenarios.task: Rig and signal a mobile crane pick of scaffolding bundles onto the left bank staging pad beside the Gardon.
hazards: crane tip-over on soft riverbank soils
load swing over walkway with public present
overhead power line contact on access road
steps: Verify load weights and chart with crane operator tailboard meeting
Walk the site to confirm exclusion zone and public barriers
Set timber matting on the bank pad and check level
Rig bundles with rated slings, tag lines attached
Direct the pick with standard hand signals; stop if any pedestrian enters zone
Land load, secure it, then release slings only on signal

rubric.pass_if: slings and shackles rated above load with correct hitch
uses standard signals and maintains eye contact with operator
zone established and enforced at all times
matting placed and crane outriggers fully extended on mats

scenarios.task: Grade the riverside maintenance track near Le Vieux Moulin for equipment access while protecting tree roots.
steps: Complete walkaround and locate utilities from maps
Establish exclusion zone and flag trail users detour
Cut fill in lifts, keeping machine level on slopes
Protect flagged trees and root zones with barriers
Compact and finish to surveyed grade
Park machine, cycle implements down, and secure site

rubric.pass_if: operates up/down slope, never across, within tip limits
no damage to marked lines; hand-digs within 1 m
finish within 25 mm of plan grade
detour and signage maintained all shift

scenarios.robot_role: Tows a compact survey marker wagon along the track ahead of the machine to hold grade stakes.

scenarios.task: Install a new GFCI-protected lighting circuit on an outdoor kiosk near the Pont du Gard visitor path.
hazards: electric shock in damp riverside location
strike-through of unknown conduits in wall
steps: Lock out the feeder breaker and verify de-energized
Scan kiosk wall for embedded conduits before drilling
Run EMT, make bends, and fasten supports
Pull conductors; terminate at weatherproof GFCI and fixtures
Energize, test GFCI trip with tester, and check fixture aim
Label panel directory and close up

rubric.pass_if: applies lock, verifies zero energy before work
GFCI and wet-rated fittings used and tested
conduit runs plumb, fittings weather-tight
GFCI trips on test button and tester

scenarios.task: Tap a new fire-suppression supply line off the site water main serving the Carrière romaine de L'Estel Sud work area.
hazards: pressurized main release during hot tap
hand injury from chain tong kickback
steps: Review tap drawing and confirm main pressure with water utility
Isolate section per permit; flush and verify depressurized where required
Excavate and shore pit; test atmosphere before entry
Cut in tee and valve; pressure-test new joint to spec
Disinfect line per potable-water procedure
Backfill, compact, and record as-built locations

rubric.pass_if: permit isolation verified before cutting
atmosphere tested and attendant posted for pit entry
pressure test holds with zero visible leakage
flush and disinfect procedure completed and documented

scenarios.task: Assist inspectors with rope-access survey of an upper aqueduct tier, hauling tools and logging defects.
hazards: fall from height on historic structure
steps: Attend morning rescue plan briefing and gear check
Establish drop zone closure below work area
Rig haul lines and tool tethers
Support inspector movement, keeping ropes clear of edges
Photograph and log defects as called out by inspector
Retrieve all tools; verify nothing loose remains before reopening walkway

rubric.pass_if: all tools tethered and zone closed below
can state rescue plan and equipment location
relays inspector calls accurately to logger
walkway reopened only after full tool count

scenarios.robot_role: Carries the inspection payload along the tier deck and streams close-up imagery, reducing human rope time under the arches.

scenarios.task: Place a concrete headwall and curbing for a French drain outfall above the Gardon bank.
hazards: trench collapse in sandy bank soil
slip trips on rebar and formwork
steps: Check trench shoring and edge protection
Set forms and rebar with proper chair spacing
Mix/place concrete at low w/c ratio; vibrate in lifts
Screed and finish curbing to line and grade
Cure with membrane and protect from river splash
Strip forms safely; backfill and compact in lifts

rubric.pass_if: shoring and access ladder verified before entry
gloves and sleeves prevent wet-cement contact
curbing within line and grade tolerance, no honeycomb
curing compound applied within spec window

scenarios.task: Clear fuel-reduction firebreak strips through scrub and wood parcels in Bois communal de Remoulins.
hazards: wildfire risk in dry mediterranean scrub
steps: Check daily fire-danger rating and permit conditions
Establish water backpack and fire extinguisher at work point
Clear strips in teams with 3-m spacing, watchers posted
Chip or stack cut material away from tree drip lines
Hydrate and rotate crew on heat schedule
Walk the completed break for smoldering material before leaving

rubric.pass_if: extinguisher and water present before cutting starts
proper grip, stance, and no cutting above shoulder
follows work-rest cycle and hydration plan
break is continuous with no skip patches

scenarios.robot_role: Hauls water, fuel, and chaps to remote scrub plots along the break line.
